scope: Functional real-socket scheduler evidence, before a range-queue experiment. No throughput ranking claimed.
reproductions: A valid request waiting for its first headers is speculatively cancelled; replacement receives 403.
Two partial-body ranges stall together while other workers finish; last-task-only handoff cannot complete before controlled release.
Immediate timer eligibility can cause a fast ordinary range to reopen during a short response gap. The exact file still completes, but an unexpected request violates the controlled range fixture.
changes: Require acknowledged data before handing off an active request; buffered data is flushed before eligibility is checked.
Allow several original ranges to yield, with at most one new request flag per idle local slot.
Track original owners in a segment-indexed vector in stable order, replacing the hash map. Replacement workers still cannot yield.
Allow a response to finish naturally for an observed request-cost grace period, bounded to 50 ms..1 s. Host capacity queues are excluded from the request budget used for this estimate.
Keep tiny-tail, validator, range-boundary, bandwidth, pause/cancel and writer-acknowledgement checks.
local_verification: Both architectures: 90 app + 2 native tests pass, nine external tests ignored, all-target clippy warnings denied.
